title: AstralAzeta's Ultimate Client
description: A client-side modpack with everything you need
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1dbafd3a354ba45106d4af368be65286272396b0.png) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Discord-Button-64.png)](https://discord.gg/hFS6faY9tW) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Modrinth-Button-64.png)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/astralazetas-ultimate-client)
UC is a client-side modpack with everything you need
Features - Simple Voice Chat Mod - Shader Support with Iris - Armor HUD and Shulker Box Tooltip - Distant Horizons - Mod Menu - Optimisation with mods like Sodium, Lithium, Entity Culling and more - No Chat Reports Mod - Optional fullbright with Gamma Utils - Custom Cape support and Wavey Capes - Better F3 screen with only essential text - Dynamic Lights - 4K screenshots with Fabrishot - Litematica Mod for builders - Easy zoom with Zoomify Mod - Flashback Mod for creators - Xaero's World Map and Minimap - e4mc
